jobs.occupation: Experienced Red Teamer / Pentester - Cybersecurity Audit (m/f/d) - DISW (Informatiker/in)
jobs.description: Start your cyber career with us!As part of the global Cybersecurity Assurance function, we help Siemens to achieve their goals by providing objective, factual and independent assurance to the Siemens Managing Board and Audit Committee. As a business partner to Siemens executive management, we leverage our expertise in a wide range of topics to create an impact that drives change. We offer a vibrant and inclusive environment which ensures a variety of perspectives and enables big picture thinking.To deliver on our vision of being pioneers in assurance and a talent incubator for Siemens, we offer a unique Grow and Development Model. We believe in the concept of lifelong learning and therefore encourage our people towards a mindset where continuous upskilling and reskilling becomes a natural part of our career. We invest in our expertise and therefore provide continuous career coaching, trainings and mentoring, all whilst working with top Siemens business leaders on multiple high-profile projects around the world.Our Cybersecurity team provides core assurance over the cybersecurity health of the company which includes IT infrastructures, product security, software development and cloud environments. We are on the lookout for people with a great skillset, an international mindset and new ideas who understand Siemens businesses and how Cybersecurity helps enable and increase market value. Are you one of them?To discover more about the global Siemens assurance function click here (https://assets.new.siemens.com/siemens/assets/api/uuid:832d2c5d-e30c-4163-a1be-9fa3d67f645b/controlling-and-finance-assurance-info-for-applicants.pdf) .What part will you play?- As valuable member of the assurance team you will be responsible for conducting and driving Cybersecurity assessments across the entire Siemens landscape, including products, services, IT-systems, and software development centers. During this process you will plan and perform ethical hacking activities, design attack scenarios for state-of-the-art technologies and highlight important observations to translate technical findings into management information so that they can take effective actions. - Apply advanced hacking principles and red team methodologies, tools and techniques to mimic real-world threat behaviors faced by the Siemens’s digital environment, e.g. cloud applications, on-premise infrastructure, digital products and services.- You work closely with cybersecurity experts from multiple industries to improve their solutions by tackling the root cause of the issues and find innovative solutions to modern challenges.- You independently conduct research on latest developments in cybersecurity technologies and threats and understand how this is impacting and changing the Siemens’ environment.You'll win us over by having the following qualifications:- Strong academic history (Bachelor degree) in IT, Computer Science or other related fields; certifications such as GIAC GPEN, OSCP, OSWE, CRTO, CREST, etc. are a plus. - Good scripting and programming skills and experience with languages such as Bash, Python, Powershell, and C++ / C#.- At least 5+ years of professional full-time working experience within Siemens or a related industry in penetration testing / red teaming with a proven record of continuous career development.- Demonstrated affinity to learn about the latest trends in cybersecurity and keep up to date in a continuously challenging environment.- You have solid experience with one or more of the following aspects of penetration testing / red teaming: application and software security, EDR and antivirus evasion, C2 setup, automation and scaling of security testing, Active Directory attacks, etc.- Demonstrated experience in capture the flag (CTFs) events, bug hunting or vulnerability research (CVEs) is a plus.- Experience with leveraging and integrating AI into day-to-day work is considered an advantage.- Fluent in English. German or other languages are a plus.- You demonstrate an international mindset and are open to international travel, and working in a diverse teamWhile commitment to our job improves performance, growth happens when we stretch beyond our comfort zone. FIN A offers ample opportunities to seek the challenge:Caring for the world around us is a crucial part of our working culture at FIN A for over a decade.Everyone at FIN A has the possibility to actively engage in our global Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) community and make an impact with our socially and environmentally motivated CSR projects.What we offer- 2 to 3 days of mobile working per week as a future global standard- An environment where everyone can bring their whole self to work and feel a sense of belonging- 30 leave days and a variety of flexible working models that allow time off for yourself and your family (for Germany)- Share matching programs to become a shareholder of Siemens AG- Pension plan to ensure financial security - 50+ learning hours per year for both personal and professional growthWhy us?Working at Siemens Digital Industries Software means flexibility - Choosing between working at home and the office at other times is the norm here. We offer great benefits and rewards, as you'd expect from a world leader in industrial software.We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of  , religion, color, national origin, ___ , gender, gender expression,   orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.We look forward to your application! Please use only our career platform, which you can access via "Apply now". Send us an email to careers-DACH.sisw@siemens.com, if you would like to clarify initial questions with our recruiting team. Contact person for this job advertisement is Nadia Dzianisawa. jobs.occupation: Technical Account Manager SEA (f/m/d), Berlin (Account-Manager/in)
jobs.description: Do you want to put your SEA expertise to work in a role where technical excellence, performance and continuous account optimization take center stage? Then you've come to the right place. Your mission As a Technical Account Manager, you will be responsible for the operational and technical management and development of SEA accounts. Your role is fully focused on hands-on technical account work without direct client contact. Your goal: Drive SEA account and campaign performance through professional setup, continuous optimization and data-driven analysis. Your Daily Business Setting up, managing and continuously optimizing SEA accounts and campaigns Driving the technical development of campaigns across Search, Shopping, App, YouTube and Display Analyzing account and campaign performance and identifying errors and optimization opportunities Creating reports, analyses, dashboards and data-driven evaluations to support informed decision-making Developing technical roadmaps to achieve relevant performance targets Developing creative and strategic solutions to continuously improve and advance SEA accounts Contributing to working groups, task forces and projects focused on developing technical and SEA-related topics What makes you stand out +5 years of relevant professional experience in SEA/Paid Search, with strong hands-on experience in operational account and campaign management Strong technical understanding of SEA accounts and solid experience in campaign setup, management and optimization Analytical and data-driven approach, with experience working with reports, dashboards and performance evaluations High quality standards and a keen eye for errors, optimization opportunities and sustainable solutions Proactive and independent way of working, combined with the motivation to challenge existing approaches and continuously improve them Fluent written and spoken English skills for successful communication with colleagues What you can look forward to Security & Stability: A permanent employment contract in an innovative company Flexibility: Remote work, flexible working hours and exciting projects #KnowledgeSharing: Access to our in-house Academy and Google Ads expertise to support your onboarding and continuous learning Professional Growth: 360° feedback and a culture where learning and continuous improvement matter Team Spirit: An appreciative working environment, flat hierarchies and genuine collaboration Work-Life Balance: Flexible working models designed to support different personal circumstances This is us At Smarketer GmbH, we are part of the Smarketer Group, THE network of specialized online marketing agencies. Our expertise is all about Google Ads and Microsoft Advertising. Since 2011, we have been delivering measurable performance through a data-driven, creative approach and a team that works together and celebrates success together. You can look forward to joining a team that supports one another, enjoys working together and is genuinely motivated to achieve great results as one. What matters to us is your talent, motivation and personality, regardless of gender, background, religion, sexual orientation, disability or age. Diversity makes us stronger as a team and more successful together. Our culture is built on focus, partnership and a strong performance mindset. We stay focused on our goals, work together as one team and celebrate when our combined efforts deliver great results. We want Smarketer to be more than just a place to work. We want it to be a place where you genuinely feel comfortable and valued.
